avis.texte: I’ve been using this facial wash for a few weeks now, and I’m honestly impressed with the results. The texture is gentle and smooth, and it creates a nice light lather without feeling too harsh on the skin. After each wash, my face feels clean and refreshed, but not stripped or dry—which is something I’ve struggled with using other cleansers. What I really like is how it removes dirt and excess oil effectively while still keeping my skin soft and hydrated. I’ve also noticed fewer breakouts and a more even skin tone since I started using it. It has a mild, pleasant scent that isn’t overpowering, which is perfect for daily use. Overall, this facial wash is a great addition to my skincare routine. It’s suitable for everyday use and works well even for sensitive skin. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and gentle cleanser.

avis.titre: Overly gentle, very few exfoliating beads
avis.texte: It’s an extremely gentle exfoliant. If you’re looking to really feel the scrub get something else.

One of my favorite face washes ever! The smell is very oat-y if you’re expecting a great fragrance it’s not the beta smell, but it is very gentle and very effective and a staple in my skincare collection which I am very consistent with. This makes me skin so soft and clean, does not dry out at all!

I love this face wash as it leaves my acne-prone/dry skin feeling clean without stripping it of all moisture. It foams like a dream and has a light pleasant oat scent which I prefer over the chemical smells most other washes have. I’m giving this a 4/5 because the little beads get in my eyes and hairline quite easily which burn my eyes and is a pain to wash out. I haven’t seen any difference in it treating my acne, but am not surprised as this cleanser is for soothing and hydration.

avis.titre: Takes make up off, and leaves skin smooth and hydrated.
avis.texte: This really removes make up better than most. It is a bit soapy so use a little dab. I made the mistake of using a average streak and I was rinsing my face a lot to remove it. I used a wash cloth the next time. Then rinsed. Left my face smooth and hydrated.

I’ve already bought a backup; it’s one of my favorite facial cleansers. It exfoliates very gently and leaves the skin clean and incredibly soft. It’s fragrance-free and perfect for sensitive skin like mine.
Favorite face wash ever. It takes off all my dead skin and makes feel super clean after I use it! Does not break me out.

L’ho riacquistato varie volte. Quando in sconto vale la pena, lascia la pelle pulita e liscia e un leggero effetto esfoliante. Forse può dare fastidio se avete la pelle sensibile, ma non è aggressivo.
Absolutely love this! Ive got a really sensitive skin & I discovered the Purito skincare range by chance! Really great for my skin, & completely fragrance free!

🦋MI OPINIÓN🦋 He comprado dos artículos porqué cuando lo prové me encantó. Lo uso máximo una vez a la semana, retira perfectamente toda la piel muerta. Es una maravilla, el olor es neutro, de producto natural. La exfoliación es muy notoria, por eso al tener la piel sensible lo uso semanalmente. La relación calidad precio está genial. Me apasiona probar productos nuevos de firmas distintas para valorar cuáles son los mejores para mí 🖤.
Really like this one, the skin feels smooth after using and doesn’t cause outbreaks. The smell is a little funny though.

avis.titre: It is ideal for oily skin
avis.texte: I loved this product because I have oily skin and acne-prone skin, and when you use it its texture is soft and feels like it has bits of oatmeal in it, it cleans deeply and above all its ingredients are very favorable for my skin type, I love it, I use it twice a week and I love how my skin looks after using it.
Me gustó mucho , huele bien, deja la piel suave y funciona súper como exfoliante, seguiré comprándolo 💯

avis.titre: Not really for dry skin, but I like it anyway!
avis.texte: Even those of us with dry, sensitive skin need to exfoliate occasionally, so I ordered this Oat Exfoliating Facial Polish Cleanser by Purito Seoul in the hopes that it would be gentle enough for me to use. It arrives in a box with a security seal, and inside is the tube of product with a foil seal under the cap. I set about to use it immediately, and was pleased to discover that this face wash is about as gentle as an exfoliating wash can be, yay! It has no added fragrance and really does not smell like much of anything, which is fine by me. The formulation contains four different mild surfactants, and they produce a soft and bouncy foam that simply feels lovely on the skin. The exfoliation part comes from oat kernel flour, so it is not hard particles, just some mild abrasion from the soft kernels. The wash rinses easily, and I was surprised to see that my skin did not feel squeaky clean from oils being stripped. To reiterate, it left my skin feeling very clean, but I did not feel as if it damaged the moisture barrier at all. I also love that the wash did not exacerbate my rosacea; after rinsing my skin looked healthy, and did not become reddened at all. The reason I say that this might not be the best product for dry skin is because in addition to the exfoliating kernels, it also contains two kinds of clay and denatured alcohol. The clay will pull impurities and excess oil out of the skin, but if you don't have excess oil ( like me), these ingredients can be drying. Having s

I love this cleanser from Purito Seoul because of how gentle it is. As someone who has super sensitive, dry, and flakey skin, I find that this cleanser is perfect for me. I always struggle with finding the perfect cleanser for my skin type because the red, inflamed parts of my face burn when I use cleansers that use harsh chemicals. Luckily, one of the top ingredients of this cleanser is oats, and oats work extremely well for calming dry, red, and irritated skin. The oats in the face wash are not fully ground into a paste. Some oat bits make this face wash to be considered an exfoliating face wash, but because the exfoliating bits are pieces of grounded up oats, it makes it gentle enough to be used as a daily cleanser that won't strip your skin of all its natural oils and over exfoliate your face to cause it to be senstiive. After using this face wash for a while, my pores have become less noticeable, and the overall health of my skin has significantly improved as well. I have a natural glow on my skin that I used to never have before. I'm super happy to report that this face wash didn't clog my pores and caused me to break out, and that it has quickly become my new favorite face wash because of how well it works for my skin type.

avis.titre: Gentle scrub but not as hydrating as I’d like
avis.texte: If you’re looking for a quality cleanser or facial scrub with a great list of wholesome ingredients this might be it. But if you have really dry skin this might leave you a little tight so it may not work as your daily. For me personally it’s not moisturizing enough for me to use as a routine cleanser but it’ll work fantastic as a weekly exfoliating scrub. While it didn’t leave me “dry” my skin felt a little tight and I know my skin and that bit of tightness is something I really have to avoid. Please keep in mind that I have *really* dry skin and unless I use very specific products my face will not only tighten but will flake and peel shortly afterwards. So I have to be very selective in what I use. Although I can’t replace my cleanser with this, this is the 1st exfoliating scrub I’ve found that I can even use. And I have to say, after polishing I used my milky toner and moisturizer to rehydrate and wow my face was smooth and clean! So I’ll have to use this infrequently but it’ll be perfect to help with my post retinol peeling or my winter flakiness.

avis.titre: Great result with just a tiny amount!
avis.texte: The first time I used this product, two things stood out. The first was that I was using way too much of the product, and could easily get away with using at most half. The second was that it seemed like there wasn't much of the actual exfoliating ingredient. But then I was surprised to find that my skin was really smooth after using it, along with feeling moisturized. The second time I used it I cut the amount down quite a bit, and still found that I had more than I needed. So I'm even more impressed that I can get a great result with only a pea-sized amount of this cleanser. I do wish the ingredient list were shorter and didn't contain so many ingredients that sound like chemicals (indicating at best they're highly processed from a natural source), but I suppose that's the tradeoff for getting such good results.

After using this oat exfoliator, I found it to be creamy with soft oat bits in them that felt calming and gentle on my skin. I have been using this pretty often to gently exfoliate my skin and I have to say, it definitely is very mild. some parts of my face (especially around my jawline) seems to be less clogged and my skin little a tad bit brighter but this was very subtle. I didn't find my skin to feel tight after using this cleanser and it didn't cause my skin to breakout so it works for my sensitive skin. Other than that, I don't feel like my skin is more hydrated or anything like that.

I just tried this and it feels so calming and soft on my skin. The texture is creamy and smooth, and it feels gentle the whole time I’m using it. It rinses off easily and leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean, not tight or stripped. After washing, I caught myself touching my face because it felt really smooth and nice. It reminds me of the kind of product I’d want to reach for when I need a gentle reset after a long day. First try and I’m already thinking about where it might fit in my weekly routine.

Korean face products might be my favorite thing and this face wash is no exception. It has a thicker texture and feels soothing on my face. You can definitely see and feel the small oat pieces. It doesn’t;t have much of a scent, kind of like unflavored oatmeal actually. It didn’t leave it feeling dry, almost that feeling of moisturizing soap that you aren’t sure if you washed it off completely, like it left a little moisture on my skin. As with my experience of 99% of Korean face washes a little goes a long way so this tube will last a very long time.

This is a pretty large tube of cleanser. The packaging is very nice and sealed. The scrub is like lotion consistency, not watery. There are little pieces in there for gentle exfoliation. My skin felt very clean and soft after use. The scrubby bits did not feel harsh or irritating. I really like this cleanser!

Super gentle on my combo skin yet pretty exfoliating and definitely skin loving, also kind of feel like soothing. One big thing I really love about this cleanser that it’s truly cleansing, especially my pores in problem tzone, where all the oils and dirt likes to hang out. Use it alone or 2 step system it’s truly fantastic hydration and no skin tightening feeling here! Super happy with quality!
